children: Bonus share alert, Oct. 9 -- Shares of JOJO Limited are likely to remain in focus next week ahead of the company's upcoming bonus issue record date. The film production, distribution and exhibition firm has fixed Monday as the record date for the corporate action.
For investors who closely track corporate actions, like dividend, bonus issue, stock split, etc, here are all the details about the next week's sole bonus issue corporate action.

The company's board of directors approved issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 1:1. It means that every shareholder will receive one bonus equity share with a face value of Rs.5 each for every equity share (with face value of Rs.5) held by them.

The board has fixed Monday, October 12, as the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for the payout. Which means that investors must own the stock before record date to secure eligibility for the corporate action.

The stock closed 1.33% higher at Rs.228 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.1,161.92 crore on Friday, October 9. The stock touched an intraday high of Rs.228 per share and an intraday low of Rs.225.05 per share.

The stock hit its 52-week high level of Rs.235.10 apiece on 21 September, 2026. It dipped to its 52-week low of Rs.72.00 per share on OCtober 9, 2025. The stock has delivered 106% return in six months, 162% return in one year, and 206% return in two years.

The company had reported a net profit of Rs.1.09 crore in Q1FY27 against Rs.1.16 crore reported in the March quarter of financial year 2025-26. Its net revenue declined sequentially to Rs.4.16 crore in Q1FY27 against Rs.12.27 crore reported in the March quarter. JOJO Limited's earnings per share stood at Rs.0.32 in the June quarter of FY27 against Rs.0.46 in Q4FY26.
